title: Revised Versions and Expired Quotes under Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
**Revisions.** When the scheduled items, the providers, the service date or — on estimate types where a recurring course is reissued on change — the frequency of a recurring course change after a Good Faith & Price Estimates estimate was furnished, a new version is furnished no later than the type's revision lead in business days before the scheduled service; a change made on the day of service is furnished on that day.

**Expiry.** A service performed after the type's validity period, counted in calendar days from the issued date of the quoted version, is re-estimated as a new version at current prices.

**Which version counts.** Only the latest version furnished before the service is the estimate compared with the bill.

## Points of judgement

| Event after the estimate was furnished | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Service date moves | new version, furnished no later than the revision lead before the service |
| A provider is added or replaced | new version on the same terms |
| Change made on the day of service | new version furnished that day |
| Frequency of a recurring course changes, on a type that reissues on such a change | new version |
| Service performed after the validity period of the quoted version | new version at current prices |

## Example (hypothetical)

Version 1 was issued, then version 2 was furnished after the service date moved, and the service was performed. Version 2 is the estimate compared with the bill; version 1 is not.
